english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for saying that something is true most of the time or in most cases.

exampleSentences.english: I mostly stay home on Saturdays.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我多數星期六留喺屋企。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 do1 sou3 sing1 kei4 luk6 lau4 hai2 uk1 kei2

english.note: Use this when largely means that most people, cases, or occasions fall into the stated category.

exampleSentences.traditional: 多數人都贊成呢個做法。
exampleSentences.jyutping: do1 sou3 jan4 dou1 zaan3 sing4 ni1 go3 zou6 faat3
